SuperSLM -- vendored source dependency

Tag:    v1.9.0
Commit: d870d27863c73afb0d558b376f5e8ad84f83951c
Source repository: the upstream SuperSLM repository (not this repository)

Vendored 2026-08-22 (at v1.2.0, corrected the same day), re-pinned to v1.5.0 2026-09-18,
to v1.7.0 2026-09-23 (1.6.0 was skipped), to v1.7.1 2026-09-24, and to v1.9.0 2026-09-25 (one
pin from v1.7.1; 1.8.0 and 1.8.1 were skipped; the tag, never main), in a clone of the upstream
repository, via:
  git ls-tree -r v1.9.0
  git cat-file blob <blob id>   -- per file, the raw blob written to this tree

This tree is the tag's full source distribution (CMakeLists.txt, cmake/, include/, src/,
tests/, tools/, docs/, build.bat, build_cert.bat, license and policy files), byte-identical to
`git show v1.9.0:<path>` for every file, except `.github/` (CI workflow definitions for the
upstream repository, not consumed by this plugin's own build). 892 files, each re-checked at
re-vendoring time against its tag blob id: 852 at v1.7.1 plus 40 files added by v1.9.0, with
none removed (up from 845 at v1.7.0, 684 at v1.5.0 and 526 at v1.2.0). The 40 added files are
three release notes, one CI checker under tools/ci/, four under tests/ci/, and test suites
under tests/; none is a library source, so the wrapper set is unchanged. The product change
across v1.7.1..v1.9.0 is: 1.8.0's GPU allocation-failure status contract (src/gpu/,
include/superslm/gpu_1p0.h, gpu_port.h, checked_chain_funnel.h, src/sslm_abi.cpp); 1.8.1's
per-site saturation counts through CPU prefill and prefix adoption (src/sslm_abi.cpp); and
1.9.0's CPU save format SSB5 (src/sslm_abi.cpp; SSB4, SSB3 and SSB2 still restore) and the
map-time damped-greedy i-exp peak check (src/damped_greedy_phaseD.cpp,
include/superslm/sslm_phaseD.h). The shader set is unchanged at 35.

**The first vendoring pass at v1.2.0 (2026-08-22) was corrected the same day**: `git archive`
on Windows applies `.gitattributes`' `text`/`eol=crlf`
line-ending rules exactly as a normal checkout would, so every `*.cpp`/`*.h`/`*.md`/etc. file
(marked `text`, tool-native on checkout) came out CRLF-converted -- 357 of 526 files differed
from the tag by line endings only, content unaffected. `git show <tag>:<path>` does not apply
this conversion -- it returns the raw blob -- so every re-vendoring since, including this one,
reads every file that way instead of via `git archive`.

This plugin never consumes a prebuilt SuperSLM binary. It builds this tree from source with the
engine's own toolchain, which is why
the full CMake project -- including its test and tool executables' source, not only include/
and the library sources -- is vendored: CMakeLists.txt declares those targets unconditionally
at configure time, and configure fails if their sources are absent.

Do not hand-edit any file under this directory. A correction to SuperSLM is made upstream and
this tree is re-vendored at the new pin. `VENDORED_MANIFEST.sha256` records this tree's own
per-file hashes at vendoring time, checked by `ci/tests/test_vendored_tree_checks_run_in_ci.py`
against the COMMITTED tree at every `ci/tests` run -- a hand-edit that alters any file's content
fails that check. (`ci/check_vendored_tree_matches_manifest.py` and
`ci/check_vendored_wrappers_complete.py` are the checkers; `ci/tests` runs them, and the
repository's coherence-checks workflow runs them too.)
